callStructure.means: Formation, then protection, then concept words. Protection is a number plus a word (2 or 3 Jet, Scat, Scram; hundreds on quick game), a run number with P in front for play pass, or FK plus the run plus Keep for a boot. After that comes the front-side concept, often with a position letter saying who runs the tagged route (Z Stick, F Arches). Any second word is the backside tag or the back (Bow, Swab, Trash, H Coin). Both means mirror it. A (can) splits two full calls.

protections.means: Six-man: five linemen plus the back. Line slides away from the call (Rams sort big-on-big vs odd fronts). Back double reads the linebackers inside-out to the call side, then gets out. Hots are built in.
protections.onFilm: Back steps up and scans before leaking out late. Line sets as a unit one way. TE and every receiver are out. The hundreds version shows up on quick game.

protections.means: Five-man. Line takes the four down plus the widest threats and slides away from the call. Back free releases, and the 2 or 3 tells him which way. QB is hot off the extra rusher.
protections.onFilm: Back is gone at the snap with no look at a rusher. Five linemen only. Ball comes out fast if a sixth man comes.

protections.means: Same five-man rules as Scat with nobody left to protect: GB defines it as the empty version. The digit still sets the slide and the hot side.
protections.onFilm: Empty backfield (back split out or motioned out), five linemen, quick throw or a hot when a sixth rusher shows.

protections.means: Full-turn protection. Every lineman takes the first gap away from the call, the TE stays in on the end, and the back fits the C-D gap off the TE block. Rams carry it as a one-back audible protection.
protections.onFilm: Whole line turns the same way at the snap. TE blocks, back fills outside him. Seven stay in, so expect only two or three in the route.

protections.means: Six-man with the TE in and the back out. Line has the four down and the declared Mike, Y has Sam or hangs on the end, back free releases. QB can re-Mike.
protections.onFilm: TE stays in and blocks while the back releases right now. Opposite picture from Jet.

protections.means: Seven-man slide with two backs. Line slides away from the call, fullback takes the outermost rusher and halfback the innermost to the call side. Turns into full turn vs Bear or Jam.
protections.onFilm: Two-back set, both backs attack downhill like draw to the same side, line slides the other way. Two or three man route, usually deep.

protections.means: Seven-man, man protection. Line has the four down and Mike. Strong back has the outside backer to his side, weak back has the one to his. TE free releases.
protections.onFilm: Two backs each step to their own side and check an outside backer. No slide by the line: linemen set on a man.

protections.means: Seven-man slide with TE and back on the play side. Rules flip on whether the play-side guard is covered: TE takes the end or pairs with the tackle on end and Sam, back fits C-D or Mike to strong safety.
protections.onFilm: TE and back both stay in to the same side. Line slides or sorts based on a 3 technique to that side.

protections.means: Jet answer to double-A-gap mug looks. Call-side guard and tackle block man on, center and the backside slide the A/B/C gaps, and the back takes the call-side A gap with no scan. QB makes the call.
protections.onFilm: Two backers mugged in the A gaps. Back steps straight into the A gap instead of scanning wide.

protections.means: Unclear from text. Sits in the protection slot on Rams 7-step, can and red zone calls where Jet would be. Not defined in the sections read.
protections.onFilm: Unclear from text. Chart the slide and who stays in when a known Jax concept shows up.

protections.means: Unclear from text. Protection word on the Rams empty crossing concepts (Samurai, Sensei, Shredder, Mexico). Not defined in the sections read.
protections.onFilm: Unclear from text. Shows with empty formations and deep crossers.

protections.means: Six-man turn protection with a hard run sell by the call-side guard and tackle. Fullback bluffs the edge and runs to the flat, halfback cuts the first defender outside the tackle, TE releases.
protections.onFilm: I-formation lead look. Tailback dives at the edge defender, fullback slips to the flat, TE runs the Banana.

protections.means: Wide zone sell. Backside guard and tackle take three hard run steps then square up. The F sifts back across to the weak-side edge, and turns it into a slide if two come off that edge.
protections.onFilm: Stretch look one way, a fullback or wing cuts back across the formation to block the backside end. QB sets up behind it.

protections.means: Zone sell with the TE sifting back across to the weak-side edge. Backside line sells run three steps then anchors. Back fakes, checks the play-side blitz, then flat. GB fakes 18-19, Rams fake 16-17.
protections.onFilm: Stretch fake, TE comes back across the ball to block the backside end, back continues into the flat.

protections.means: Wide zone sell with the F or Y bending back to the weak-side edge. Backside line three hard steps then square. Back sells the run through the D gap and checks to the flat. Bluff, Lick and Rib tags ride on it.
protections.onFilm: Stretch fake with a bender coming back across late. Looks like split-flow wide zone until the QB pulls it.

protections.means: Wide zone sell with the F bending to the strong-side edge while the Y leaves that defender for him. Backside line sells run then anchors. Back fakes and works to the flat.
protections.onFilm: Stretch fake, QB sets up (no boot). An off-ball F picks up the first man outside the TE on the strong side.
protections.note: Paired on the Waggle word and the F blocking the strong-side edge. Rams add Wiggle and the Y blocking the backside edge.

protections.means: Inside zone weak lead sell. Line works to Mike, backside tackle and TE own the end and Sam, fullback has Will on or off the ball. Back deepens, sells, and can abort for a secondary blitz.
protections.onFilm: Two-back inside zone look with the fullback leading weak. QB turns his back, sets up in the pocket.

protections.means: Seven-man off inside/tight zone action. Line works to Mike, backside tackle and TE handle end and Sam, back checks Will to any secondary blitz then the flat. Solid adds the F and makes it eight.
protections.onFilm: One-back downhill zone fake under center, TE stays in. With Solid a second back or wing also stays. Deep two-man routes behind it.

protections.means: Play pass off the inside zone Man (lead) run. Line blocks the run aggressively, TE blocks Sam or slams, fullback has Will, back sells and checks.
protections.onFilm: Two-back lead fake to the TE side with the fullback hitting the linebacker.

protections.means: Play pass off inside zone Split action. Fullback comes back across for Sam or Mike depending on Sam alignment, line works to the other two backers.
protections.onFilm: Split-zone look: fullback crosses the formation behind the line as the back fakes downhill.

protections.means: Play pass off the Wanda Man run. Line works to the first backer in the box call side, the F or Y blocks the second one, back checks Sam to secondary blitz.
protections.onFilm: Downhill zone fake with a lead blocker inserting on a linebacker.

protections.means: Gap-turn protection selling 34/35 Wanda. Y or F cross-sifts to the edge and pins. Back has the first defender inside the Y.
protections.onFilm: Gun inside zone fake with a TE or wing crossing to the far edge.

protections.means: Seven-man off Duo action. Line blocks Duo hard and has the four down plus Mike and Will, TE blocks the end, back sells and takes any secondary blitz. Rams use it vs sub and time it as 5 step.
protections.onFilm: Downhill Duo double teams up front with low hats, TE blocking, QB fakes and sets quick.

protections.means: Play pass off the Dos run. Line blocks it hard and has the two inside backers, TE blocks the end, F runs a route, back sells and has secondary blitz.
protections.onFilm: Bunch or tight formation, downhill fake, one receiver from the bunch released late off a stalk.

protections.means: Six-man off Duo. Line sells Duo backside and man blocks the call side: four down plus first backer inside-out away from the call. Back has the play-side backer. 5 step timing.
protections.onFilm: Duo fake with only six in. TE is out in the route.

protections.means: Down-block scheme with the off guard pulling for the edge. TE has Sam or the end, back fakes and gives inside presence weak. Solid keeps the fullback in to help the TE.
protections.onFilm: Pulling guard on a pass. Gap-scheme run fake with the QB setting up behind the puller.

protections.means: Inside zone sell with the line working to the middle of three box backers. Backside tackle and TE take the end plus a backer or DB depending on the look.
protections.onFilm: Inside zone fake vs a walked-out Will. Otherwise looks like Willie.

protections.means: Six-man gap protection with an attack pull. Line sells the downhill run, backside guard pulls for the edge with the back as his inside sideboard, TE releases. GB also carries a 38/39 version.
protections.onFilm: Guard pulls on a pass from a clean box. Back fakes then blocks inside the puller. Often the first half of a can.

protections.means: Play pass off 18 with the center or left guard wheeling back for the edge rusher. TE or F stalks then releases.
protections.onFilm: Stretch fake with an interior lineman peeling back to the open edge.

protections.means: Play pass off Wizz action. Backside line takes three or four hard steps and settles, TE sifts through the B gap.
protections.onFilm: Gun run fake with the TE inserting through the B gap rather than crossing the formation.

protections.means: Play pass off inside zone F Sift. F sifts to the weak-side edge. TE blocks the run then leaks late (Faucet).
protections.onFilm: Inside zone split-flow fake. Watch the TE: he blocks, then slips out late across the field.

protections.means: Keeper-look protection off mid zone where the QB pulls up instead of breaking contain. Backside guard and tackle invite the backside tackle inside and pin him so the QB can set in the C gap.
protections.onFilm: Looks like a boot, but the QB stops and sets just outside the tackle box and throws deep or back across.

protections.means: Break-contain keeper. Line blocks the zone run full speed. A sifter works the backside and slips out late if the end closes. Back sells the fake and has the play-side edge or flat. GB fakes 18-19, Rams 16-17.
protections.onFilm: Full stretch fake one way, QB boots out the back door naked or behind a sifter. Ralph and Larry are the GB code words.

protections.means: Keeper off the two-back Weak run. Fullback sells Weak and works to the weak edge (wheel), halfback fakes and has the corner or safety blitz on his way to the flat.
protections.onFilm: Two-back zone fake, fullback leads away, QB boots opposite.

protections.means: Same keeper with the fullback given the Brake assignment.
protections.onFilm: Fullback starts with the run fake then stops and comes back toward the boot side.

protections.means: Keeper where the line stays firmer on the line of scrimmage so the F can slide behind them to the boot side. Play-side tackle stays tight on the nearest end or backer.
protections.onFilm: A wing or fullback runs flat behind the line toward the boot and is the first throw.
protections.note: Slick and Skate both tell the line to stay firm on the LOS for a slide route. Paired on that, not on a shared word.

protections.means: Break-contain movement with the back releasing to the flat right away. Line blocks keeper technique away from the roll. Rams: back and QB both fake away first.
protections.onFilm: QB rolls with the back already running to the flat in front of him. Little or no real run fake.

protections.means: Keeper off the Stutter gap run. Down scheme with the off guard pulling for the edge, TE slams then flat.
protections.onFilm: Pulling guard plus a boot. QB takes three quick steps of fake and gets out.

protections.means: Sprint-out. Every lineman steps firm to the call side, secures his gap and seals back. Back blocks the end man and cuts him if two show.
protections.onFilm: No fake. QB sprints out behind the back, line reaches the same way. Short yardage and goal line.

protections.means: Break-contain keeper off tight zone instead of the wider zone. Line sells the combinations five steps then finishes play side. Sifter and back rules match the base keeper.
protections.onFilm: Downhill inside fake, then a boot. Tighter and quicker than the stretch keeper.

protections.means: Two-count screen to the back. Line sets a slide away from the screen, then the play-side guard, center and backside guard release: first out kicks, second works the alley, third peeks and seals. Install name is Special Screen.
protections.onFilm: Normal dropback set for two counts, then three interior linemen leak to one side with the back settling behind them.

protections.means: Screen to the back off a chip. Back shows a chip on the edge rusher then turns in for the ball, interior three release. GB times it at one count, Rams at two off Jet rules.
protections.onFilm: Back hits or bluffs the end, turns back to the QB right behind the line. Scat-type alignment by the back.

protections.term: P15 / P14 William Screen to HB
protections.means: Three-count play-action screen to the back off Willie protection. Interior three block the fake then release. Rams split it by the fake: House is the zone fake, Hefner the flash fake.
protections.onFilm: Inside zone fake, QB drops deep and drifts, back slips out the side he faked to with linemen in front.

protections.term: P15 / P14 Willie Screen to Y
protections.means: Three-count screen to the TE off Willie. TE blocks three counts then turns for the ball. Screen-side tackle always releases, center is second out if the front allows.
protections.onFilm: Play-action look, TE blocks then releases flat behind the tackle. Deep routes clear his side.

protections.term: P15 / P14 Weak Screen to Y
protections.means: Same TE screen off the two-back Weak fake. Fullback blocks Will.
protections.onFilm: Two-back zone fake with the TE slipping out late.

protections.means: Quick perimeter screen to the outside receiver on a two-man side. Play-side tackle flashes the edge then releases to the number two defender, guard to three, center to four. G.E. tag has the tackle grab the end.
protections.onFilm: Ball out now to the widest receiver stepping back. Slot blocks the corner, tackle arrives outside-in.

protections.means: GB quick screens with the same interior release. Jailbreak goes to Z with the tackle staying on the edge rusher. Prison shifts the count out one for a three-man side. Alcatraz goes to the back split out.
protections.onFilm: Receiver or split back catches behind the line coming inside, with the guards and center out in front.

protections.means: Rams quick screens to a three-man side. Klay and Curry go to the outermost receiver, Giannis to the number two. Tackle, guard, center set, stop and go to defenders three, four and five.
protections.onFilm: Trips or bunch side, immediate throw, two receivers block out front and linemen release flat.
protections.note: Could be the same idea as GB Prison (counts start at the number three defender). Not paired: cannot confirm from text.

protections.means: Quick screens thrown behind a wide zone fake. Play-side tackle and guard step down then release to the defenders over the receiver. Alley is the 2x2 version, Path the 3x1 version.
protections.onFilm: Whole offense sells stretch, QB turns and throws back out to a receiver. Often the second half of a run can.

protections.means: Two-count inside screen off Flow 6-7 action, to the back or the Y. Line full turns away from the call and the free lineman climbs.
protections.onFilm: Lead-run look, back or TE pops inside the tackle for a short throw.

protections.means: Full three-count screen to the back off Waggle protection.
protections.onFilm: Stretch fake with the QB setting up, then a throwback screen to the back.

protections.means: Three-count screen to the back off Web protection. Sifter still goes to the weak edge. Back fakes, catches and runs for width.
protections.onFilm: Bend-action play pass that turns into a wide screen to the back.

protections.means: One-count screen to the back off Scat protection. Back cheats to six yards and swings. Screen-side tackle blocks one count then releases for the man on the back.
protections.onFilm: Back swings wide and deep at the snap, tackle peels out after him.

protections.means: Three-count screen off sifter (keeper) action thrown to the F.
protections.onFilm: Looks like the keeper. The sifter stops behind the line and the ball goes back to him.

families.name: Quick game (3 step)
families.means: Three-step timing, mostly 200/300 Jet or Scat. One short concept per side, ball out on the last step.
families.onFilm: QB catches and throws or takes three quick steps. Routes break at 5 to 6 yards. Line sets firm and short.

families.name: Dropback (5 and 7 step) and empty
families.means: Straight dropback off Jet, Scat or Scram with a front-side concept plus a backside tag. Rams call many of them as man/zone cans.
families.onFilm: No run fake. Back scans or releases. Routes break at 10 to 20.

families.name: Play pass
families.means: QB sets up in the pocket behind a full run fake. Protection is named by the run it copies (P15 Willie, P18 Web, P12 Duo, Punch).
families.onFilm: Line fires out low like run, QB turns his back, then sets inside the tackles. Two or three deep routes.

families.name: Movement (keepers, rolls, sprint)
families.means: QB leaves the pocket: Keep (boot off zone fake), Roll (back to flat first), Q8/Q9 sprint-out.
families.onFilm: QB outside the tackle box with a flood of routes to his side.

families.name: Screens
families.means: Slow and chip screens to the back, play-action screens to back or TE, and quick perimeter screens to receivers.
families.onFilm: Linemen release downfield after one to three counts, or right now on the quick screens.

families.name: Red zone
families.means: Concepts built for a short field: rubs, back-line routes, pylon routes. GB lists them by yard-line band.
families.onFilm: Inside the 20. Routes aimed at the pylons, the back line and one yard into the end zone.

families.name: Two minute
families.means: Hurry-up menu and the clock plays. Mostly base dropbacks called by number or code word.
families.onFilm: No huddle, 11 personnel, same few formations.

families.name: Situational
families.means: Clock management plays and scramble rules.
families.onFilm: End of half or game. Kneel, spike, centering run, throwaway.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs the 5-yard Stick, the man outside or inside him runs the Flat, a third sits Over the ball. Backside is a Thunder one-on-one. Back checks slow.
concepts.onFilm: Three-step, ball out on rhythm. Out-breaking stick at 5 with a flat under it, a sitter over the ball, backside hitch.

concepts.means: Stick and Flat mirrored on both sides of a 2x2 or tight set. Back checks thru as the outlet. Also the Rams "Sticky-Sticky" hurry-up call.
concepts.onFilm: Same stick-flat picture to both sides at once.

concepts.means: Both outside receivers run Omaha (5-yard speed out, fade vs cloud). Inside receivers run Coin in GB, Stick in the Rams book. Back checks thru.
concepts.onFilm: Mirrored quick outs by the two widest receivers off a 4-step stem. Corner playing off gets the out, rolled-up corner gets the fade.

concepts.means: Both outside receivers run hitches (Hitch in GB, Thunder in Rams, fade vs press). Inside receivers run Coin or Stick. Rams T.O. tag turns one hitch into a double move.
concepts.onFilm: Mirrored 5 to 6 yard hitches outside with inside sitters. Slots lose two on their split.

concepts.means: Trips quick game. Thunder by the outside receivers, a seam or Stomp alert up the slot, and a short inside route (Coin in GB, Stick plus widen Omaha in Rams). Back checks slow.
concepts.onFilm: Trips side: hitch outside, vertical from a slot, short sitter inside. Hitch on the single side.

concepts.means: Rams trips quick game: Thunder outside, Go alert, Stick and Coin inside with a widen Omaha.
concepts.onFilm: Trips hitch-stick picture with one receiver running off on a go.

concepts.means: Double slants to both sides: inside receiver slants first and crosses face, outside receiver slants behind him.
concepts.onFilm: Two slants stacked on each side, three-step, ball to the second window.

concepts.means: Rams partner to Lions built on Snag routes with a Sluggo alert and an option route. Exact assignments unclear from text.
concepts.onFilm: Receivers start like shallow crossers then snap back out. One outside receiver sells slant and goes.

concepts.means: Slant-flat. Outside receiver runs Glance, inside receiver runs the Flat or Drag. Usually with a tag: Y Over (TE sits over the ball), Lion (double slants backside), Wheel (flat turns up).
concepts.onFilm: Slant with a flat under it from the same side, Scat or 200 Jet. With Wheel, the flat runner turns up the sideline.

concepts.means: Rams Scat quick game. Tagged receiver runs Arrow with a Corner over it and a Flat. Bow side is Basic over Arrow.
concepts.onFilm: Short sit routes at 5 with a corner over the top on one side, dig over a sit on the other.

concepts.means: Stick and Flat to one side, Bow (Basic over Arrow) to the other. From Scat or Scram. GB carries it as a red zone quick.
concepts.onFilm: Stick-flat one side, dig over a short sit on the other. Back released or empty.

concepts.means: Stick and Flat to one side, Bark (Basic over Dart) to the other. Rams call the same backside Bullet. Rams also list Cheddar and Dairy backsides.
concepts.onFilm: Stick-flat one side. Other side: short receiver angles in like Arrow then bursts across flat under a dig.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1 Scat quick game. Tagged receiver runs Spot (5-yard sit inside), back runs Wide, with a Flat. Backside tag picks the other pair.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch or trips: one receiver sits at 5 inside, back swings wide to that side.

concepts.means: Empty. Tagged slot runs Lookie (vertical stem, sped-up choice, cross face if he can). Others run Stick Nod and Stick China with a Go outside. Bamboo shows a Basic.
concepts.onFilm: Empty set, slot works a quick option off a vertical stem. Next to him: one stick turns up, one snaps back in.
concepts.note: Ninja and Chops paired because both show Stick Nod plus Stick China next to the Lookie.

concepts.means: Rams empty concept: Shallow Cross, Faulk, two Dunny routes, a C.O. and a Go alert. Assignments unclear from text.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. One shallow, one in-breaker at 5 behind it. Vs known man the ball goes to number one.

concepts.means: Coco is Corner over C.O. (back or slot breaks out under the corner). Backside is Bow or Swab. Back checks wide. Rams show Coco only in the red zone Joe package.
concepts.onFilm: Corner route with a short out under it on the tagged side. Dig over a sit or over a shallow on the other.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Coin (sit or break) with a Thru behind it and a mandatory-outside-release Go. Cut and Target set the backside (Under hot or Arrow hot).
concepts.onFilm: Inside receiver works a two-way option at 5, deep in-breaker over him, outside go.

concepts.means: Both outside receivers run Scout (hitch at depth, fade vs cloud). Tagged inside receiver runs Snag. Snout puts Snag and Scout on one side with Bow backside.
concepts.onFilm: Two outside stop routes with a slot starting across then snapping back out.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Shallow Cross. A Deep Sit settles over the ball behind it. Backside runs a widen Post or Swig. Archo tag gives the F the Arches double move. Back checks wide.
concepts.onFilm: One man running flat across at 5, a sitter at 10 to 12 over the ball, post behind it.

concepts.means: Shallow Cross and Deep Sit, with Glare on the other side: Glance outside and a Rail from inside.
concepts.onFilm: Shallow and sit, plus a slant with a wheel-type route outside it.

concepts.means: Empty (Scram). Tagged receiver runs Coin. Buffalo side is Thru, Pick Curl and Now. Go with outside release.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Three-man side: one flat under on the move, one curl working off a pick, one deep in-breaker.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver or the back runs Choice: 4 to 6 yards, three-way go. A Bench or Comeback clears outside him. Tag sets the rest. Rams run Choice with X Diagonal and Y Coin.
concepts.onFilm: Isolated slot or back breaking in, out or sitting at 5 with the outside receiver cleared off deep. Slot may miss the count.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Flag with an Omaha China or Drag China under it. Backside is Bow or Swab.
concepts.onFilm: Flag route with an out-and-back-in under it. Dig combination on the other side.

concepts.means: Tagged outside receiver runs Go. Thru from inside with an Under beneath it from a plus-3 split. Pump version doubles the Under (Under Pump or Under Return).
concepts.onFilm: Go outside, deep in-breaker, and a 5-yard under from a wide split. Red zone install.

concepts.means: Go Shade with a Shallow Cross added underneath.
concepts.onFilm: Go, deep in-breaker, under and a shallow coming from the other side.

concepts.means: Scat. Back or F runs C.O. Shadow side has Go, Thru, Under and Shallow Cross. Coco version adds the Corner over the C.O.
concepts.onFilm: Back releases and breaks out. Other side floods with go, dig-type route and under.

concepts.means: Scat. Back runs C.O. under a Corner. Mini side: Mini route wraps the hook defender with Thru and Now.
concepts.onFilm: Back breaking out under a corner. Other side has a 6 to 8 step in-breaker wrapping behind the hook player.

concepts.means: Jet with Rib or Lick. Tagged receiver runs Mini, Thru over it, Comeback outside. Trash backside: Shallow Cross that stays on the move with the back on Check Trail.
concepts.onFilm: TE or wing chips then flats. Shallow never sits and the back trails behind it.

concepts.means: Cash shows Strike, Under and Coin with the back involved. Called with a can to the Strike Pump version. Assignments unclear from text.
concepts.onFilm: Strike-type in-breaker at 10 with an under beneath it. Can version: same stem turns into a double move.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Flag with an Under beneath it. Swab backside: Basic over Shallow Cross.
concepts.onFilm: Flag and under on one side. Dig with a shallow coming under it from the other.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Tree (10 yards, speed cut to 12 at the sideline) with a Go clearing. Other side is Drive, Swab or Trash.
concepts.onFilm: Speed out at 10 to 12 completed outside the numbers under a go. Shallow-dig on the other side.
concepts.note: Rams Pressure route equals GB Tree, and both Trash versions show Clear, Shallow Cross and Check Trail.

concepts.means: Shallow Cross by the tagged receiver with a Basic behind it from the same side. Post or Go clears on top. Back checks burst. X Scout or Individual tags the single side.
concepts.onFilm: Shallow and a dig from the same side, post over the top. Classic drive picture.

concepts.means: Scat red zone version of Drive with a Drag China and a Go.
concepts.onFilm: Shallow with an out-and-back-in route next to it, tight red zone.

concepts.means: Jet Bang. Both outside receivers run Bench (speed cut at 15 to 20). Tight players bang the ends then run flats. Back checks option.
concepts.onFilm: Tight 2x2. Mirrored deep outs with flats under them after chips.
concepts.note: Rams list Obama next to Bang Bench on the same page. How Obama differs is unclear from text.

concepts.means: Jet Bang. Both outside receivers run Swirl (sell corner, come back to the QB). Bang Flats underneath, back checks option.
concepts.onFilm: Mirrored corner stems that stop and come back at 15. Chips and flats under.
concepts.note: Rams Bozo variant shows a Basic and a Swirl T.O.

concepts.means: Jet Bang. Both outside receivers run Bike (sell the Bench three steps, break back in to the hole). Bang Flats, back checks option.
concepts.onFilm: Looks like Both Bench until the receivers snap back inside.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Sail under a Blazer with a flat: three-level flood. Bingo backside is the Blazer with a Basic. Runs from H2/H3 or Jet Rib.
concepts.onFilm: Flood one side: clear-out deep, out at 18 to 22, flat. Dig backside.
concepts.note: Bingo paired on Blazer plus Basic showing in both books.

concepts.means: Jet Bang. Tagged receiver runs Swirl Pump (sell the Swirl, go). Bow backside. Bang Flat and Bang Arrow under.
concepts.onFilm: Corner stem, hard stop, then gone. Shot play off Both Swirl.

concepts.means: Four verticals from 2x2: Go outside, Seams inside reading the middle of the field. Scooter or Scab turns one outside Go into a stop or comeback. Back checks option.
concepts.onFilm: Four receivers vertical on landmarks. Seams bend vs two high.

concepts.means: Trips verticals: Seam and Go with a Thru from the inside. Back on Coin or Burst. Spock is the Trash version.
concepts.onFilm: Trips side all vertical, one bending across as a deep in-breaker. Back sits underneath.
concepts.note: Rams 3x1 verticals are called Dancer. Not paired: cannot confirm from text.

concepts.means: Scat. Clear and Go stretch deep, Thru in the middle. Back runs C.O. with a Flat. Cut backside is the Under.
concepts.onFilm: Verticals with one in-breaker, back released out to the flat area. Can be Oscared.

concepts.means: Tagged inside receiver runs Attack at the Mike (replaces him vs Tampa 2). Seams or Seam Stop next to it, Scout outside. Back on Check Sneak. Rams use Attack in the red zone with H Coin.
concepts.onFilm: Middle receiver straight at the Mike and into the hole. Seams hold the safeties.

concepts.means: Tagged outside receiver runs widen Curl. Curl Thru works over the hook defender inside, Flat is hot. Back runs Burst across, or Trail with the Trash tag.
concepts.onFilm: Curl outside at 12, in-breaker over the linebackers, back crossing under at 4 to 6.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Trunk (8 to 10 yards, breaks in or out by leverage). Thru and Comeback with it. Cut or Target sets the Under or Arrow side.
concepts.onFilm: Inside receiver breaks at 8 to 10 away from his defender. Comeback outside.

concepts.means: Tagged slot runs Arches: sell the seam, break in at 5, cross face. Outside receiver clears with Bench or Clear. Backside has Eliminator or Shallow. Rams call the route and concept Faulk, usually first half of a can.
concepts.onFilm: Slot widens like a seam, snaps inside at 5 on the move. Outside receiver takes the corner deep.

concepts.means: Arches with Clear and Comeback on the outside. Artichoke gives the tagged man Archo (sell Arches, back out) with Swab.
concepts.onFilm: Arches look where the slot snaps back out to the sideline.

concepts.means: Empty verticals with the back or F running Now under it.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Four vertical with one quick under on the move.

concepts.means: Empty. Storm has Seams with the tagged man on Juke (sell Thru, cross face or sit). Can to Shot: Stomp from the slot with Locked Thunder outside.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Inside receiver jukes at 4 to 6 between two seams. Can version: slot go with outside stops.

concepts.means: Empty. Shot side: slot Stomp, outside Locked Thunder. Buffalo side: Thru, Pick Curl, Now.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Slot fade over a stop one side, pick-curl triangle on the other.

concepts.means: Empty. Shot to both sides with the back or tagged receiver on Middle (attack the backer, bluff, get by).
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Two slot fades over stops, one man up the middle of the field.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Pull (4 to 6, turn in, pivot away if matched) with Pull Basic behind and a Shallow Cross. Outside runs Shake or Bench. Can is to the Pump version.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch. Short pivot route with a 10 to 12 yard in-breaker over it. Often paired with Cowboy as a man-zone can.

concepts.means: Trips or bunch. Spin by an inside receiver with a Go clearing. Tagged receiver runs Swirl, or Coin with a short widen Dover.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch: corner-stem comeback at 15 with a spinning underneath route.

concepts.means: Max protect (H2/H3) shot. High Cross from one side, Corner Post from the tagged receiver, widen Go. Backs check.
concepts.onFilm: Seven-man protection, two or three in the route. Deep crosser with a corner-post behind it.

concepts.means: Scat mesh. Low and High Shallow Cross rub over the ball, Deep Sit behind them, Go outside. GB cans from it to Pull Swish for man vs zone.
concepts.onFilm: Two shallow crossers passing each other at 4 to 6, a sitter at 10 behind the mesh.

concepts.means: Jet Rib or Lick from bunch. Thru and Shallow Cross with the back on Check Star (same-side burst). Tagged outside route is Stogie or Scooter.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch with a chip-flat. Back starts out then bursts back across. Outside stop route.

concepts.means: Jet Rib or Lick. Push runs through the near safety, tagged receiver runs widen Dover (Dagger in Rams) into the space. TE slams then trickles out. Single side tag: Comeback, Stogie, Shake or Blink.
concepts.onFilm: Inside vertical drags the safety off, deep in-breaker at 15 to 20 behind it. TE chips. Back checks.

concepts.means: Deep Thru clears the middle, widen Dover breaks in behind it at 15 to 20. GB runs it off Willie Solid play pass and as a two-minute dropback (X Dagger Y Shallow Z Scout).
concepts.onFilm: Inside receiver vertical at the safety, outside receiver deep dig behind him. Shallow under it on the dropback version.
concepts.note: Rams use Dagger as the route name (GB Dover) inside Blade, Boat, Pearls and Dribble.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1 on Jax. Shallow Cross with a Dagger and Basic behind it. Single receiver gets the Indy route (Comeback or Go). Back checks burst.
concepts.onFilm: Trips: shallow, dig, deeper dig stacked across the field. One-on-one outside away from it.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1 with Rib or Lick. High Cross clears, Dagger breaks in behind it, Dagger Pivot under. TE slams first. H runs Wide. X tag: Stutter, Stem Go or Swirl T.O.
concepts.onFilm: Deep crosser followed by a deep dig from the same side. Back swings wide. Single receiver double move.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1. Safe is a Field Post by X. Blast or Blink by the tagged receiver, Swirl outside, Rib Flat under. Read It makes the Blast a read.
concepts.onFilm: Post from the single side over the top of a bunch-side comeback and flat.

concepts.means: Rams flood. Tagged receiver runs Sail under a widen Blazer with a Rib or Lick Flat. Backside X runs Dagger or Basic. Back checks coin. Dunny version adds Y on Dunny.
concepts.onFilm: Three-level flood: clear-out, sail at 18 to 22, flat after a chip. Deep in-breaker backside.
concepts.note: Tagged route is the Sail, same as GB Sail Bingo. Kept separate: the word Boat is not in the GB book.

concepts.means: Rams 2x2 with Rib or Lick. Push and Dagger like Spear with a Comeback outside. Dapper swaps in a Pylon. Coins puts back and chipper on Coin routes.
concepts.onFilm: 2x2 Spear picture: vertical at the safety, deep dig behind it, comebacks outside.

concepts.means: Rams bunch. Search finds the void between the hashes. Tagged receiver runs Swirl (Warrant), Blink (Badge) or Blast. Rib Flat under, TE slams, back wide.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch: one man settling in the middle hole, outside comeback off a deep stem, flat.

concepts.means: Rams bunch. Pylon over a Swirl with a Rib Flat. X backside runs Dagger or Basic (or Basic T.O.). Back checks coin.
concepts.onFilm: Deep corner-type route to the pylon over a 15-yard comeback and a flat.

concepts.means: Rams empty crossers on Scrabble. Far Cross and Low Cross with a widen Dagger, flats after chips. Sensei shows Sail and Deep Diagonal, Shredder shows Blazer and Deep Skinny.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Receivers crossing at two depths with a deep in-breaker over them.

concepts.means: Rams 4x1 can. X Slant or Sluggo as the Indy with Duck to the loaded side (Under, Corner, Wide). Zone answer is the second call.
concepts.onFilm: Four to one side. Single receiver slant or slant-and-go.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1 verticals: Go outside, Seam and Diagonal inside. Trash adds the Shallow Cross and Check Trail. Switch crosses the releases. It is the 3x1 call for 911.
concepts.onFilm: Trips all vertical with one bending to the middle. Shallow and back trailing underneath.

concepts.means: Rams empty can. F Swim with X Diagonal and Y Coin, Swirl and Go outside. Coin-Steal is the zone answer.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Similar to Choice Diagonal with a different slot release.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1 can on Jax. Y Go, Snag, Basic and Special. Zone answer second.
concepts.onFilm: Trips with a snag and a dig, TE vertical.

concepts.means: Rams 3x1 can. Under (or Under T.O.), Special, Snag and Go with H Coin.
concepts.onFilm: Under from a wide split with a deep in-breaker. Back sits.

concepts.means: Rams mesh can. Low and high Shallow Crossers, Deep Sit setting depth behind them, Corner. 3x1 version adds H Rail. Same family as GB Cowboy, Redskin and Chief: not paired, cannot confirm from text.
concepts.onFilm: Two shallow crossers rubbing, sitter over the ball, back up the sideline.

concepts.means: Rams empty can. Steal (Coin-Steal) with Special, Stomp, Now and Locked Thunder.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Slot fade over an outside stop with a now route under.

concepts.means: Rams empty can. Glance with a Rail, Under and Shallow.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Slant with a wheel outside it, under coming back the other way.

concepts.means: Rams empty crossers on Scrabble. TE slams then releases, High Cross between numbers and hash with a depth-setting route under it, Blazer outside, Bang Flat. Also the can off Cross play pass.
concepts.onFilm: Empty. Deep over route with a clear-out in front of it.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Strike: 7 steps, break in to the hole just outside the hash. Opposite receiver runs Streak or Comeback. Back checks flat. GB runs it off many fakes and often as a run can.
concepts.onFilm: Hard run fake under center, in-breaker at 10 thrown on the QB's last step behind the sucked-up backers.

concepts.means: Strike from one side, Blaze Out (Blazer stem, 90 degree out at 22 to 25) from the other. Rams list Swirl, Blink and Blast as the other choices.
concepts.onFilm: Strike window first. If it is covered, the deep out on the other side.

concepts.means: Strike with a Swirl on the other side. GB runs it off Willie, Web Bluff and Wizz, and cans it to Sweat (Field Post) vs shell.
concepts.onFilm: Strike in-breaker one side, corner-stem comeback the other.

concepts.means: Rams. Start action with Strike or Basic, H Coin, Stalk Rail. Sifter blocks and can slip to the flat as the hot.
concepts.onFilm: Run fake with a late flat by the sifter. In-breaker behind the linebackers.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Blazer (speed release, skinny through the corner at 20). High Cross comes from the other side under it. Rams add Blush and Scorch versions with Blink, Stutter or Swirl T.O.
concepts.onFilm: Max-protect play action shot. Deep post-type route down the numbers with a deep crosser coming under it.

concepts.means: Bunch off Dos or Paddy. Halo has a High Cross with receivers stalking then releasing (Stalk Shallow, Stalk Rail) and a Go. GB Shark uses a Strike Pump. Rams Halo shows a Pylon Post tag.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch sells the run block, then one leaks shallow and one up the rail. Deep crosser over it.

concepts.means: Red zone off F Bend. TE blocks the run for a three count, then leaks late across to the back pylon as a throwback. Z on Ghost.
concepts.onFilm: Everything flows one way, TE slips out late going the other. Throwback.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Read (read stem to 20, stay vertical or snap down on the safety). Lock on the other side. Backs check.
concepts.onFilm: Two-man deep route off play action. Receiver sits or keeps going based on the safety.

concepts.means: Lock or Read by X, Deep Thru from inside, and a Rail up the sideline by the tagged back or receiver.
concepts.onFilm: Deep sit at 20, deep in-breaker, and a late wheel up the sideline.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Read Out (read stem, roll out at 20 to 25). Locker crosses flat from the other side. Off Web with the bender blocking.
concepts.onFilm: Deep out breaking toward the sideline with a deep crosser coming to the same side.

concepts.means: Streak staying vertical two yards outside the hash with a High Cross under it. Possible tick or stymie at 15.
concepts.onFilm: Vertical up the seam area with a deep crosser. Shot play.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Pylon (read stem to 15, high angle to the corner) with a High Cross under it. Pylon Post leans to the pylon then breaks to the post. Rams pair Pylon (Post) with Pitch.
concepts.onFilm: Deep corner off a post-looking stem with a crosser dragging coverage. Post version breaks back inside.

concepts.means: Throttle between the hashes with a Blaze Out on the other side. Off Weasel, Willie Solid or Waggle.
concepts.onFilm: Deep crosser that throttles on the hash, deep out away from it.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Throttle (sell High Cross, sit on the near hash at 15 or run away from man). Field Post over the top. Rams pair it with Safe.
concepts.onFilm: Crosser that stops in the hole at 15 with a post behind it.

concepts.means: Punch play-pass verticals (Spock: Thru, Go, Seam, Comeback) canned to Jet Steamer.
concepts.onFilm: Guard-pull fake with trips verticals. Can version is the quick Steamer.

concepts.means: Gun Punch play-pass with a fly motion and vertical routes (Thru, Clear, widen Go), canned to Both Omaha.
concepts.onFilm: Fly motion, flash fake, guard pull. Can version is mirrored quick outs.

concepts.means: Off Split. Outside receivers run Scab (stutter comeback, sit vs cloud) with a Clear. F runs Middle after the fake.
concepts.onFilm: Comeback at 15 off a double move stem. Fullback slips up the middle past the backer.

concepts.means: Off Flow 6-7. TE or Z runs Banana, fullback runs the short flat as the hot, Shallow Crossers come from the backside. Go clears.
concepts.onFilm: Lead-run fake. Fullback to the flat, TE bending behind him toward the corner.

concepts.term: Stroke Locker / Blaze Out Locker / Shake Locker
concepts.means: Rams. Locker (read stem, flat across at 20) from one side. Other side runs Stroke, Blaze Out or Shake. Back checks flat.
concepts.onFilm: Deep crosser from a tight split with an out-breaker in front of where it is going.

concepts.means: Rams off Foam. Widen Dagger with a Pylon (Dapper) and a deep Special over. Z Stalk Flat, back checks.
concepts.onFilm: Waggle protection. Deep dig with a corner-type route beyond it.

concepts.means: Rams off Foam. Blazer and Blink with a Stutter tag. Assignments unclear from text.
concepts.onFilm: Waggle protection shot with a double move.

concepts.means: Rams off Dime with fly or flow motion. Y runs the Sail under a Blazer, H to the Flat, X Basic backside. QB reverses out.
concepts.onFilm: Motion, Duo fake, then a three-level flood.

concepts.means: Rams off Dime. Special by the tagged receiver with a Rail outside it, Clear and widen Go. Scout or Burst tags.
concepts.onFilm: Deep in-breaker with a wheel up the sideline off a motion.

concepts.means: Rams off Punch. C.O. and Start versions with Go, Skinny, Stalk Rail. Unclear from text.
concepts.onFilm: Guard-pull fake. Unclear from text.

concepts.means: Rams off Laker or Grizzly. QB gets depth and sets. A receiver or Y leaks late under the linebackers to the far side. Low Cross and Blazer or Locker hold coverage.
concepts.onFilm: Boot look that pulls up. Late leak going against the flow, usually wide open or not thrown.

concepts.means: Rams off Foam. High Corner thrown back (T.B.).
concepts.onFilm: Flow one way, throwback deep corner the other.

concepts.means: Rams off Grizzly. Y Strike or a Read It route with a Low Cross and late leak. Tags Slacker, Smash, Settle. Unclear from text.
concepts.onFilm: QB gets depth and sets off a keeper look. Unclear from text.

concepts.means: Rams off Paddy or Milf. Z Cross with a depth-setter and the back checking. Called with a can to Mexico.
concepts.onFilm: Duo fake, deep cross behind the linebackers.

concepts.means: Base keeper flood. Low Cross from the backside at 10 to 12, Flat or late Down Flat by the TE, High Corner or Far Corner deep. Backside receiver runs Runback.
concepts.onFilm: Stretch fake, QB boots. Three levels to the boot side: flat, crosser, corner. Comeback away.

concepts.means: Keeper with the Y on a Shallow Cross instead of the late Down.
concepts.onFilm: Boot with the TE running under the linebackers right away.

concepts.means: Keeper with a tagged receiver or F on Slide: start on the fake side, slide behind the line to the boot side as the first read. F Corner variant uses a Me/You call.
concepts.onFilm: Boot with someone running flat behind the line toward the QB side at the snap.

concepts.means: Keeper off a toss fake.
concepts.onFilm: Toss look, QB boots away. Same flood.

concepts.means: Keeper with the edge pinned and a Smash route to the boot side. GB also runs Stutter Pin Keep. Rams run Keep Smash from 3x1 width.
concepts.onFilm: Boot where the outside receiver pushes 5 and snaps up at the sideline.

concepts.means: Keeper with Y or X on Leak: run flat under the linebackers against the flow. With F Brake the fullback stops and comes back.
concepts.onFilm: Boot one way, one receiver sneaking the other way behind everyone.

concepts.term: Keep Fluster / Keep Flow (Husker, Slacker, Slalom)
concepts.means: Rams keeper variants. Fluster adds H Sneak and an Oscar alert. Flow bunch versions tag one route: Husker, Slacker or Slalom.
concepts.onFilm: Same boot picture with motion in front of it.

concepts.means: Rams keeper off tight zone. Low Cross, Corner, Flat, with a TE slam or insert. Oscar, Flock and Fly versions.
concepts.onFilm: Inside zone fake then boot. Routes same as Keep.

concepts.means: Rams keeper with the play-side tackle pulling to the alley (T call) to lead the QB.
concepts.onFilm: Tackle out in front of the booting QB.

concepts.means: F Roll with Z on Banana (3-yard split) and X on a Shallow Cross. Fullback short flat hot. QB reverses out. Rams red zone version is Roll Rt Fly (Husker).
concepts.onFilm: QB rolls with the fullback in the flat and a receiver bending to the corner behind him.

concepts.means: Sprint-out. Pick Bench with a Slant inside it, Whirl backside. Called with a run can in the low red zone.
concepts.onFilm: Sprint out to a bunch or stack. Outside man works over the top of a pick to the sideline.

concepts.means: Two-count slow screen to the back off Jet. Receivers block the deep defenders, QB five steps and drifts.
concepts.onFilm: Back steps into the line like protection, then leaks behind three releasing linemen.

concepts.means: One-count chip screen from a Scat alignment. Back shows chip and turns in.
concepts.onFilm: Back bumps the end and turns around for the ball.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver screen (X or Z Astro) with quick-game looking routes away: Coin, Omaha, Hitch.
concepts.onFilm: Quick game picture on one side, receiver screen on the other.

concepts.means: Quick screen to the outside receiver. Slot pushes up on number two to buy the tackle time. GB Felon and Crook are the direction words.
concepts.onFilm: Outside receiver pops back, catches, runs inside the tackle's block.

concepts.means: Play-action screen to the back off Willie. Z runs Pylon and a High Cross clears. Solid tag keeps the F in.
concepts.onFilm: Bad-on-purpose run fake, deep routes run off coverage, back slips out late.

concepts.means: Second half of a wide zone can (Zorro or Zap). Quick screen to Z or X with the tackle and guard releasing.
concepts.onFilm: Stretch look, ball thrown out to the receiver with linemen leading up the alley.

concepts.means: Screen to the back off bend action with fly motion.
concepts.onFilm: Motion, bend fake, back catches and runs wide.

concepts.means: Quick screen to Z with three interior linemen out.
concepts.onFilm: Receiver catches coming inside behind a wall of linemen.

concepts.means: TE screen off Weak or Willie. X runs Pylon and a High Cross clears.
concepts.onFilm: TE blocks three counts then turns for the ball.

concepts.means: Screen to the sifting F off keeper action, Z on Blazer.
concepts.onFilm: Keeper look, throw back to the sifter.

concepts.means: Flow Screen is the can off Flow Banana Cross. Path is a 3x1 quick screen to X off a fake truck or toss.
concepts.onFilm: Lead fake then inside screen. Or toss fake with a throw out to the single receiver side.

concepts.means: Rams quick screen to the outermost receiver of a three-man side. G.E. tag has the tackle grab the end.
concepts.onFilm: Trips or bunch. Number one steps up one to three steps and catches, two and three block.

concepts.means: Rams quick screen to the number two receiver of a three-man side. Frog and Madison are the direction words.
concepts.onFilm: Bunch screen to the middle man.

concepts.means: Scat mesh. High and Low Shallow Cross, Deep Sit behind them, Corner. Redskin has the back on Rail, Chief is the bunch version with a Flat.
concepts.onFilm: Red zone mesh: two crossers, a sitter, a corner to the pylon.

concepts.means: Scat mesh variant with a Basic and Corner over the shallows and the back on Rail.
concepts.onFilm: Mesh with a dig behind it.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs widen Skinner (double up, post). Now Return under it, Thru inside. Back on Burst, or Pile tag.
concepts.onFilm: Skinny post with an in-then-out route beneath.

concepts.means: Scat. Skinner with a Wheel under it and Dart or Swirl away. Can flip to Shield or Omaha.
concepts.onFilm: Skinny post with the back or slot wheeling outside it.

concepts.means: Empty. Widen Scooter outside, Nash or Now Return inside, Pile and Corner working the pylons.
concepts.onFilm: Empty in the red zone. Short hot throws with a corner.

concepts.means: Stick Nod by the tagged receiver with Omaha China or Drag China and a Corner.
concepts.onFilm: Stick that turns up the field, out-and-in routes around it.

concepts.means: Race along the back line (save 2), Whirl, Deep Shallow two yards into the end zone, Hammer Pivot. Back bursts or runs Rail. GB route tree calls this picture Racer, which is the Rams name.
concepts.onFilm: Receivers working the back line and back pylon with one crosser just inside the goal line.
concepts.note: Paired on matching routes (Race, Whirl, Deep Shallow, Pivot) and the GB route tree naming a Racer concept.

concepts.means: Stick Nod and Stick China with a Glance. Sumo (Scram) adds Sluggo Under from a plus-3 split and a Fade.
concepts.onFilm: Two stick looks, one up and one back in. Slant from outside.

concepts.means: War route one yard into the end zone on the numbers landmark, Corner behind, widen Arrow or Flat under. Tag sets the other side or the back.
concepts.onFilm: Goal line: receiver sits just across the line, corner to the back pylon.

concepts.means: Tagged receiver runs Jo (at the Mike, break vertical). Swirl outside, Pile to the pylon, Now under.
concepts.onFilm: Inside receiver stutters at the linebacker and goes up the middle.

concepts.means: Rub concept. Outside receiver releases outside and pushes to 5 or two yards into the end zone (Surge Arrow), inside receiver runs flat under him off the natural pick (Surge Flat). Rams call it Point.
concepts.onFilm: Stack or tight split near the goal line. Outside man up, inside man out under him.

concepts.means: Rams. F Spray is a speed cut or stick-type option. Y Drive is Basic over Shallow Cross, Z Whirl backside. Called as a can or run-pass.
concepts.onFilm: Red zone 2x2. Slot option at the sticks, shallow-dig the other way.

concepts.means: Rams. Choice with an In next to it. Dart, Dart Read or Chops on the other side. Fade and Omaha outside.
concepts.onFilm: Slot option route at 5 with an in-breaker beside it.

concepts.means: Rams. Money route (sit or break in at 5) by the tagged receiver with Dart or Chops away.
concepts.onFilm: Two-way option at 5 inside, sticks or dart on the other side.

concepts.means: Rams. Like Racer with Back routes (save 2, double up to the back pylon), Race, Deep Shallow, Pivot.
concepts.onFilm: Back line and back pylon routes from trips or bunch.

concepts.means: Rams. Fly motion flat with low and high shallow crossers and a Back route on the end line.
concepts.onFilm: Motion man to the flat, two crossers behind him.

concepts.means: Rams empty can. Joe with Coco (Corner over C.O.) or Oakley, a low Shallow Cross, widen Omaha and Race.
concepts.onFilm: Empty in the red zone. Corner with an out under it.

concepts.means: Heavy personnel passes. Flow Stay X Corner, Full X Fade Z Slam, Double Fade, Lead Z Cross. Short Corner with inside release, fullback short flat.
concepts.onFilm: Tank personnel, run fake, one receiver to the back pylon or a fade.

concepts.means: GB numbers ten dropbacks for hurry-up: Dragon Denver and Disk, Both Dragon, Stitch, Omaha, Go Shade, Aggie Scooter, Attack, Arches, Fun Swab, Drive, Special, Dagger, Shallow Glare, Mink.
concepts.onFilm: No huddle, same 11 personnel sets (Trips, Dice). Recognize the base concept, not a new play.

concepts.means: Trips Scat. X Dragon (slant-flat) with Denver or Disk to the trips side: Stick and Under from a plus-3 split. Unclear from text beyond that.
concepts.onFilm: Slant-flat to the single side, short stick routes to trips.

concepts.means: Rams sideline play on Scat. Sail and Flat with a Go, X on Bench or Pressure.
concepts.onFilm: Out-breakers at three depths, all headed for the boundary.

concepts.means: Rams in-bounds chunk plays for Down-Down situations: Spear, Lions (double slants) and the Samurai crossers.
concepts.onFilm: Middle-of-field throw, runner gets down, offense sprints to clock it or calls timeout.

concepts.means: Rams final plays. Hail Mary with jumper, front tip and back tip spots. 5 Verts with a can to the Curry screen.
concepts.onFilm: Last play. Bunch running to one spot in the end zone, or five vertical.

concepts.means: Rams preset hurry-up calls. 911 is Double Rt Off 3 Jet verticals (Aggie in 2x2, Dancer in 3x1). Sticky-Sticky is Snug double stick. Swoosh is the shot version.
concepts.onFilm: Offense sprints to the same formation and snaps on first sound.

concepts.means: Rams clock plays. Center runs to the middle for the kick. Foul Ball is a boot and throw away deep to burn the last seconds. Victory is the kneel. Clock is the spike.
concepts.onFilm: Not a real pass concept. Chart it as situational.

concepts.means: Rams. When the QB breaks the pocket: receivers to his side go deep or come back, backside receivers work across. In the red zone the deep man goes to the back pylon and the short man to the front pylon.
concepts.onFilm: Routes break off and mirror the QB once he leaves the pocket.

concepts.means: GB two-minute code words map to the Special Chip Screen and the Astro screens.
concepts.onFilm: Hurry-up with a screen called by one word.

routes.note: Red zone. Save 2 from the end line, break to the back pylon.
Used in play diagrams, not in the route tree. Unclear from text.
Diagram labels on Sensei and Shredder.
Close to GB THRU. See THRU.
Used in play diagrams, not in the route tree. Unclear from text.
Close to GB DRAG CHINA. Not paired.
GB lists GO, GO (M.O.R.) and GO (WIDEN) as three entries. Rams list WIDEN GO.
Rams Stitch draws the outside hitch as THUNDER. GB has both HITCH and THUNDER.
Diagram label in both books (Rams Bleach / Leak, GB Keep Y Leak). No route tree entry in either.
Pump (GB) and T.O. (Rams) both mark the double move off this route. Paired on that.
Rams keep OVER for the version that can slide back and use OTB for the static sit.
Rams tree only describes READ T.O. and refers back to a Read route.
Same name, different job: GB Search is a red zone seam that hooks up. Rams Search finds the void between the hashes.
GB Shake comes off a Strike stem, Rams Shake off a Glance stem.
Not the Rams SKINNY.
Not the GB SKINNER. Rams Skinny is a straight-stem in-breaker off the Strike stem.
Rams write it T.O. and also use T.O. as a suffix on other routes.
Rams also list DIAGONAL with nearly the same description.
Pump (GB) and T.O. (Rams) both mark the double move off this route. Paired on that.
Pump (GB) and T.O. (Rams) both mark the double move off this route. Paired on that.

tags.means: Two plays called in the huddle. The first one runs unless the QB says "Can, Can" in the cadence, then it is the second. GB writes the reason after the second play (Shell, Rotation, Box Issue, Man/Zone). Rams label the second play Zone Answer.
Flips the direction of the play from a mirrored formation. Alerted in the huddle ("Alert Oscar") and triggered in the cadence. On pass calls it flips the concept to the better side.
QB word that cancels a Can or Oscar and goes back to the original play.
Full audible word in the cadence, followed by a new run or protection with hand signals. Mainly for all-out pressure.
Diagram label on a deep route: a shot the QB takes only with the right look, outside the normal progression. Also the huddle word that announces an Oscar.
Label on the route that replaces a free rusher. Jet has hots built in. In Scat and Scram the QB is hot off the unblocked man.
Label on the backside one-on-one route in quick game (usually Thunder). QB decides before the snap whether he takes it.
Both sides run the tagged route (Both Omaha, Both Stitch, Both Bench, Both Lion). Rams use a concept word for the mirrored version instead.

tags.term: Position letter before a route (X, Z, Y, F, H)
tags.means: Names who runs the tagged route or is the primary in the concept: "Z Stick", "F Arches", "H Coin".
Backside pair: Basic with an Arrow under it.
Backside pair: Basic with a Dart under it. Rams word for the same pair is Bullet (Bullet Read when the Dart is a read).
Backside pair: Basic with a Shallow Cross under it.
Rams backside tags next to Bow and Bullet. Cheddar shows a China route, Dairy shows Diagonal and Skinny. Exact pairing unclear from text.
Rams tag pairing Stick China and Stick Nod. GB Ninja shows the same two routes.
Backside Shallow Cross that never sits (Trash Shallow) with the back on Check Trail behind it.
Three-man side: Thru, Pick Curl and Now.
Backside tags on Coin, Florida, Coast and Trunk. Cut shows an Under that is hot. Target shows an Arrow. Unclear from text beyond that.
Tags behind Go, C.O. and Coco: a Thru with an Under beneath it. Shadow adds a Shallow Cross. Shade Pump turns the Under into a double move.
Backside pair: widen Scout outside with Stick China inside.
Names the back route at the end of the call: "Curl Burst", "H Coin", "H Wide". It is the Check version of that route unless the protection frees him.
Inside receivers or TEs hit the edge rushers on their way out, then run flats. Goes with Jet or Scat.
Chip-and-release by a tight player on one side: he bangs the edge then runs the flat (Rib Flat, Lick Flat). Direction by first letter is an inference.
Suffix that turns a route into a double move: Swirl Pump, Under Pump, Strike Pump, Omaha Pump. Rams suffix is T.O. (takeoff).
Suffix: sell the out-breaker for four steps then snap back inside (Stick China, Omaha China, Drag China, Flat China).
Suffix: show the break, then go back up the field (Stick Nod).
Suffix: sell the in-breaker then break back out (Under Return, Now Return, Thru Return, Skinner Return).
Prefix: release wide first to stretch a tight split (Widen Go, Widen Curl, Widen Dover / Dagger).
Mandatory outside release on a Go or Whirl.
Backside single receiver gets his own tagged route. Rams shorten it to Indy.
Rams tag that makes the tagged route a read (Blast Read It, Strike Read It).
Keeps the F in the protection. Makes Willie an eight-man play pass.
GB play-pass tags. Insert adds a receiver into the run-fake fit. Switch has the two deep-route runners trade releases.
Unclear from text. A tagged receiver assignment on GB play pass (Read Ghost, Throttle Z Ghost), drawn as a hot. Not in the route tree.
Motion tags attached to play-pass, keeper and screen calls. They change who sells the run look, not the protection rules.
Tells the TE or F how he handles the backside edge on play pass and keepers: sift across, bend back, bluff and release, pin inside, or T for the tackle pulling to the alley.
Keeper tag: a receiver slides flat behind the line to the boot side and is the first read. Line stays firm for it.
Rams keeper tags that change one route in the flood. Husker shows a Me/You exchange on the Corner and Down. Smash adds a Smash route. The rest are unclear from text.
Rams Jet line calls. Ringo and Lucky set the slide right or left. Flipper is the QB flipping it vs two unknown rushers to the back side. Out moves the point past the middle.

tags.term: Rip / Liz, Ralph / Lester, Big Dual, Squeeze
tags.means: Rams Scat and Scram line calls for the five-man slide and its exotic-look answers.

tags.term: Ray / Lee, Rope / Loop, R / L, Dual, 5-0, Gap, Wrap
tags.means: GB line and back calls inside Jet and Scat. Not matched one-to-one with the Rams calls.

tags.term: Poker / Bullseye, T.O. (turn out), Hard, Scan
tags.means: Rams calls. Poker or Bullseye locks the line on five known rushers. T.O. turns the TE and tackle out on a choke player. Hard is the guard and back swapping. Scan is the back vs four weak.

Rams end-of-half words. Clock spikes it. Down-Down means get down and call timeout, clock it, or run the field goal team on. Sticky-Sticky and 911 are preset quick plays. Omaha Gimme is a free out vs soft coverage.
